findings.title: Revoked source-file admission does not fence execution or publication
findings.detail: FIXED: readAuthority checks INCLUDED sealed files for ADMITTED state. Revision transition locks also acquire file transition locks at store.ts:265 and :274. ExecuteProject checks sourceFilesAdmitted at packages/application/src/execution/handlers/execute-project.ts:124; lostAuthority checks it at apps/control/src/execution/authority.ts:43. The database publication guard locks the files and checks their admission at packages/persistence/migrations/0024_execution_review_fixes.sql:45 and :61.
findings.reproduction: Inspected passing regressions at packages/persistence/test/execution-migrations.test.ts:822, apps/control/test/job-execution.test.ts:281 and apps/api/test/cmd036-execute-project.test.ts:327. They delay EXECUTION_CONTROL, revoke included-file admission and verify blocked database publication, cancelled admission and ExecuteProject refusal, including an admitted positive neighbour. Passing entries appear at verify.log:492, :769 and :880.

findings.title: A PARTIAL cleanup permanently prevents further scratch cleanup
findings.detail: FIXED: discovery permits PARTIAL cleanup retries after backoff, stopping after CLEANED or five passes. apps/control/src/execution/janitor.ts:73 applies the same completion/pass checks. Migration 0024 replaces one-record uniqueness with numbered append-only passes at packages/persistence/migrations/0024_execution_review_fixes.sql:94 and :105.
findings.reproduction: Inspected apps/control/test/staging-janitor.test.ts:176: one injected EIO records PARTIAL, the next due sweep removes scratch and appends CLEANED, and subsequent cleanup is refused. The bound test at :199 verifies five PARTIAL passes and no sixth; exhausted failures remain recorded for operator action. Both pass at verify.log:811 and :812.

findings.title: Delivery read-back failure is forgotten after a crash
findings.detail: FIXED: publication replay reads persisted read-backs and derives the classified failure from a negative DELIVERY record before skipping existing copies. It invokes failFor at :758; failFor at :476 atomically fails the attempt/job and revokes the private package.
findings.reproduction: Inspected apps/control/test/job-execution.test.ts:431 and its crash injection at :386. The negative read-back commits while the job remains VERIFYING; event replay then produces FAILED/DELIVERY_READBACK_PARTIAL_BLOB, REVOKED package, no AVAILABLE event and released ACTIVE capacity at :453–457. The test passes at verify.log:774.

findings.title: Transient host-report failure permanently discards cleanup cost evidence
findings.detail: FIXED: a resources() exception marks the report UNAVAILABLE and forces PARTIAL at :165–176, preserving retry eligibility. packages/persistence/src/execution/store.ts:1043 persists report status; packages/persistence/migrations/0024_execution_review_fixes.sql:103 prevents CLEANED with an UNAVAILABLE report. A subsequent pass can append recovered resource and cost evidence.
findings.reproduction: Inspected apps/control/test/staging-janitor.test.ts:213. An injected report timeout leaves the first cleanup PARTIAL despite successful deletion; after host recovery, the next due sweep records CLEANED with the reported machine, runtime, cost and currency at :236–239. The test passes at verify.log:813.
